title: AN OFFER IS SHOWN ONCE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never repeats what is already on screen. A trade offer said Offered or offers you in the feed while the offer line under the boss bar already named who, what, the key and the seconds, so those two lines are gone. The lines that say an offer ran out or was not taken were said from the drawing code; they now come from the update as one feed row each, OFFER FROM NAME EXPIRED and NAME DID NOT TAKE THE ITEM.
now: A trade offer is shown once, on the offer line, and its end is one short feed row.
